d: Prominent celestial hunter asterism featuring the iconic Orion Belt, Betelgeuse, and Rigel.

hip-27989.x: Semiregular pulsating red supergiant marking the eastern shoulder of Orion, celebrated for historic brightness dimming episodes.

hip-24436.x: Luminous blue-white supergiant marking Orion’s western foot, the brightest star in the constellation and seventh brightest in Earth’s sky.

hip-25336.x: Massive hot B-type star marking Orion’s western shoulder, traditionally known as Bellatrix or the Amazon Star.

hip-26311.x: Luminous blue supergiant star located at the exact center of Orion’s Belt, illuminating the reflection nebula NGC 1990.

hip-26727.x: Triple star system anchoring the eastern end of Orion’s Belt near the Horsehead and Flame nebulae.

hip-25930.x: Multiple star system situated almost exactly on the celestial equator, forming the western end of Orion’s Belt.

hip-27366.x: Luminous blue-white supergiant star marking the southeastern foot of Orion.

gaia-3399063235755057792.x: Nearby young solar-type G0V dwarf located in the raised club of Orion, ~28.3 light-years from Sol.

gaia-3288921720025503360.x: Bright white-yellow F6V dwarf star ~26.3 light-years away representing the primary star of Orion’s shield.
